glossary.definition: (1) "Bond proceedings" includes any trust agreements, and any amendments or supplements to them, as authorized by this section.
glossary.source_title: Section 151.40 - Issuing obligations for paying costs of revitalization projects.

glossary.definition: (2) "Costs of revitalization projects" includes related direct administrative expenses and allocable portions of the direct costs of those projects of the department of development or the environmental protection agency.
glossary.source_title: Section 151.40 - Issuing obligations for paying costs of revitalization projects.

glossary.definition: (3) "Issuing authority" means the treasurer of state.
glossary.source_title: Section 151.40 - Issuing obligations for paying costs of revitalization projects.

glossary.definition: (4) "Obligations" means obligations as defined in section 151.01 of the Revised Code issued to pay the costs of projects for revitalization purposes as referred to in division (A)(2) of Section 2o of Article VIII, Ohio Constitution and division (A)(2) of Section 2q of Article VIII, Ohio Constitution.
glossary.source_title: Section 151.40 - Issuing obligations for paying costs of revitalization projects.

glossary.definition: (5) "Pledged liquor profits" means all receipts of the state representing the gross profit on the sale of spirituous liquor, as referred to in division (B)(4) of section 4301.10 of the Revised Code, after paying all costs and expenses of the division of liquor control and providing an adequate working capital reserve for the division of liquor control as provided in that division, but excluding the sum required by the second paragraph of section 4301.12 of the Revised Code, as it was in effect on May 2, 1980, to be paid into the state treasury.
glossary.source_title: Section 151.40 - Issuing obligations for paying costs of revitalization projects.
